editorial:
Imagine being a hardworking dad who does everything for his kids, only to have a shady ex-wife swoop in and take them away. That is exactly what happens to Monty, a mechanic who is just trying to keep his head above water. You will feel for him right away because he is so devoted to his three daughters. To fight the legal battle, he teams up with Julia, a high-powered lawyer who is basically his total opposite. The vibe is a mix of heartfelt family moments and some loud, funny clashes as these two very different people start falling for each other while fighting for the girls.

What really works here is the emotional pull of the father-daughter bond. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the style of a Tyler Perry movie. You get some great laughs, but the courtroom drama keeps things moving. If you love stories about overcoming the odds, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in the final courtroom battle. Monty and Julia present strong evidence that the ex-wife is unfit and unstable. The judge finally sees the truth and grants Monty full custody of his three daughters. After the legal stress is over, Monty and Julia decide to give their romance a real shot. The movie ends on a happy note with the family reunited and a new love blooming for Monty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family dramas and happy endings.
